name: ESPN+ EPG
description: Generates a custom ESPN+ EPG from your IPTV playlist by matching ESPN+ streams to ESPN's Watch schedule, then creates channels and assigns EPG data in Dispatcharr. Runs automatically after every M3U refresh, and can refresh the matching playlist and guide on a Channels DVR server.
author: nick

fields.label: EPG Source Name
fields.description: Name of the EPG source created in Dispatcharr.

fields.label: Channel ID Prefix
fields.description: Prefix used to build XMLTV channel IDs.

fields.label: Starting Channel Number
fields.description: First channel number assigned; each matched channel is numbered sequentially from its ESPN+ index.

fields.label: Channel Group Name
fields.description: Dispatcharr channel group created for these channels.

fields.label: EPG Profile Name
fields.description: Dispatcharr channel profile these channels are added to.

fields.label: Playlist Keyword
fields.description: Keyword used to find ESPN+ streams in the playlist (searched case-insensitively in stream names).

fields.label: Look-Ahead Days
fields.description: Number of extra days of ESPN schedule to fetch beyond today.

fields.label: Minimum Match Similarity
fields.description: Similarity threshold (0.0 to 1.0) for fuzzy-matching playlist titles to ESPN events.

fields.label: ESPN Date
fields.description: Schedule date to fetch. Use 'today' to fetch today plus the look-ahead days, or a specific YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.label: Auto-Refresh After M3U Update
fields.description: Run this plugin automatically after every M3U refresh event.

fields.label: Refresh Channels DVR After Sync
fields.description: After a successful Dispatcharr sync, refresh the selected M3U source and its XMLTV guide on Channels DVR.

fields.label: Channels DVR Base URL
fields.description: Address of your Channels DVR server, e.g. http://192.168.0.168:8089

fields.label: Channels DVR M3U Source
fields.description: Name of the M3U playlist source on Channels DVR to refresh after each sync, e.g. 'Platinum and EPG'.

fields.label: Channels DVR EPG Lineup (optional)
fields.description: Leave blank to auto-derive 'XMLTV-<M3U source>' (the default naming for an M3U source's guide).

actions.label: Run Now
actions.description: Create/update channels, refresh the EPG source, and optionally refresh Channels DVR.
actions.confirm: Run the ESPN+ EPG sync now? This will create/update channels, refresh the EPG source, and refresh Channels DVR if configured.

actions.label: Dry Run
actions.description: Fetch and match only — no changes made to Dispatcharr or Channels DVR.
actions.confirm: Fetch and match only — no changes will be made to Dispatcharr or Channels DVR.

actions.label: Test Channels DVR Refresh
actions.description: Refresh the M3U source and redownload the XMLTV guide on Channels DVR, and report each request's URL and status.

actions.label: Validate Settings
actions.description: Check that settings are valid and the Dispatcharr database is reachable.

actions.label: Status
actions.description: Show the result of the most recent run.
